arxiv-2204-09076.title: Spatial Search via Memoryless Walk with Selfloop
arxiv-2204-09076.creator: Peter Høyer, Janet Leahy
arxiv-2204-09076.description: Abstract The defining feature of memoryless quantum walks is that they operate on the vertex space of a graph, and therefore can be used to produce search algorithms with minimal memory. We present a memoryless walk that can find a unique marked vertex on a two-dimensional grid.

arxiv-2205-09293.title: Study on the magnetic field strength of NGC 300 ULX1 2021 Study on the magnetic field strength of NGC 300 ULX1 – References
arxiv-2205-09293.creator: Y. Y. Pan, Z. S. Li, C. M. Zhang, J. X. Zhong
arxiv-2205-09293.description: Abstract NGC 300 ULX1 is a pulsating ultraluminous X-ray source (PULX) with the longest spin period of P ≃ 31.6 ​ s P\simeq 31.6\,\rm s and a high spin-up rate of P ˙ ≃ − 5.56 × 10 − 7 s s − 1 \dot{P}\simeq-5.56\times 10^{-7}\,\rm s\,s^{-1} that is ever seen in the confirmed PULXs.

arxiv-2305-16803.title: Quantum work extraction efficiency for noisy quantum batteries: the role of coherence
arxiv-2305-16803.creator: Salvatore Tirone, Raffaele Salvia, Stefano Chessa, Vittorio Giovannetti
arxiv-2305-16803.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Salvatore Tirone, Raffaele Salvia, Stefano Chessa, Vittorio Giovannetti. Quantum work capacitances and maximal asymptotic work/energy ratios are figures of merit characterizing the robustness against noise of work extraction processes in quantum batteries formed by collections of quantum systems. In this paper we establish a direct connection between these functionals and, exploiting this result, we analyze different types of noise models mimicking self-discharging (amplitude damping channels), thermalization (generalized amplitude damping channels) and dephasing effects (simultaneous phase-amplitude damping channels).

arxiv-2310-05092.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models with Augmented Instructions for Fine-grained Information Extraction
arxiv-2310-05092.creator: Jun Gao Huan Zhao Yice Zhang Wei Wang Changlong Yu Ruifeng Xu
arxiv-2310-05092.description: Abstract Information Extraction (IE) is an essential task in Natural Language Processing. Traditional methods have relied on coarse-grained extraction with simple instructions. However, with the emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs), there is a need to adapt IE techniques to leverage the capabilities of these models.

arxiv-2403-05657.creator: François Baccelli, Bharath Roy Choudhury
arxiv-2403-05657.description: Abstract Consider a stationary sequence X = ( X n ) X=(X_{n}) of integer-valued random variables with mean m ∈ [ − ∞ , ∞ ] m\in[-\infty,\infty] . Let S = ( S n ) S=(S_{n}) be the stochastic process with increments X X and such that S 0 = 0 S_{0}=0 .

arxiv-2404-19277.title: Bridge to Non-Barrier Communication: Gloss-Prompted Fine-grained Cued Speech Gesture Generation with Diffusion Model
arxiv-2404-19277.creator: Wentao Lei, Li Liu, Jun Wang
arxiv-2404-19277.description: Abstract Cued Speech (CS) is an advanced visual phonetic encoding system that integrates lip reading with hand codings, enabling people with hearing impairments to communicate efficiently. CS video generation aims to produce specific lip and gesture movements of CS from audio or text inputs.

arxiv-2507-07669.title: Universal Spin Models are Universal Approximators in Machine Learning
arxiv-2507-07669.creator: Tobias Reinhart, Gemma De les Coves
arxiv-2507-07669.description: Abstract One of the theoretical pillars that sustain certain machine learning models are universal approximation theorems, which prove that they can approximate all functions from a function class to arbitrary precision. Independently, classical spin models are termed universal if they can reproduce the behavior of any other spin model in their low energy sector.

arxiv-2602-17961.title: DuoTouch: Passive Two-Footprint Attachments Using Binary Sequences to Extend Touch Interaction Conference: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 13–17, 2026; Barcelona, Spain Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (C
arxiv-2602-17961.creator: Kaori Ikematsu, Kunihiro Kato
arxiv-2602-17961.description: Abstract . DuoTouch is a passive attachment for capacitive touch panels that adds tangible input while minimizing content occlusion and loss of input area. It uses two contact footprints and two traces to encode motion as binary sequences and runs on unmodified devices through standard touch APIs.

europmc-pmc1854914.creator: Gross J, Schnitzler A, Timmermann L, Ploner M.
europmc-pmc1854914.description: Successful behavior requires selection and preferred processing of relevant sensory information. The cortical representation of relevant sensory information has been related to neuronal oscillations in the gamma frequency band. Pain is of invariably high behavioral relevance...

pmc-10600079.title: Quantitative and clinical implications of the EARL2 versus EARL1 [18F]FDG PET-CT performance standards in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-10600079.creator: Maurice C. Cox, Tijn Jurcka, Anne I. J. Arens, Maartje C. van Rijk, Johannes H. A. M. Kaanders, Sven van den Bosch
pmc-10600079.description: BackgroundThe EANM Research Ltd. (EARL) guidelines give recommendations for harmonization of [18F]FDG PET-CT image acquisition and reconstruction, aiming to ensure reproducibility of quantitative data between PET scanners. Recent technological advancements in PET-CT imaging resulted in an updated version of the EARL guidelines (EARL2).

pmc-11449307.title: Optimization on overall performance of Modified Ultrafine Cementitious Grout Materials (MUCG) and hydration mechanism analysis
pmc-11449307.creator: Junxia Zhou, Lanchang Zha, Shiyu Meng, Yu Zhang
pmc-11449307.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Given the challenges encountered in injecting grout into micro-cracked rock masses, a modified ultrafine cementitious grout material (MUCG) was developed using ultrafine cement, polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) fibers, and a high-efficiency superplasticizer. To identify the optimal ratio of constituents for grouting these rock masses, extreme difference and multiple linear regression analyses were conducted based on test results of flowability and mechanical properties.

pmc-11613665.title: Candidate genes in canine hepatocellular carcinoma for molecular targeted therapy
pmc-11613665.creator: Toshiyuki Tanaka, Tomoki Motegi, Misaki Mori, Nanami Sumikawa, Kaito Maeda, Yasumasa Iimori, Hideo Akiyoshi
pmc-11613665.description: ObjectivesUnresectable canine hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has limited nonsurgical treatment options. Sorafenib is a targeted therapy for unresectable canine HCC. However, there are limited reports on the expression of target genes. Therefore, the efficacy of the targeted therapies for canine HCC remains unclear.Data descriptionLiver specimens were obtained from 11 dogs with HCC and four dogs without HCC.

pmc-11690992.title: HOW ARE FAMILIES INVOLVED IN THE CARE OF HOSPITALIZED OLDER ADULTS? A QUALITATIVE EVIDENCE SYNTHESIS
pmc-11690992.creator: Judith Vick, Connor Fogleman, Joseph Neiman, Sarah Cantrell, Mollie Selmanoff, Tolu Oyesanya, Karen Goldstein, Courtney Van Houtven
pmc-11690992.description: In the outpatient setting, roughly 36 million family members in the US assist with caregiving tasks for older adults including managing medications, coordinating care, communicating with clinicians, and assisting with activities of daily living. The roles and impact of family involvement during hospitalizations of older adults are less well described.

pmc-12446587.title: Increasing Prevalence of Pediatric Type 2 Diabetes in the Republic of Ireland: A National Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12446587.creator: Katie Lynam, Michael J. O'Grady
pmc-12446587.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Aims: To establish the current prevalence of type 2 diabetes in children and adolescents aged under 16 years in the Republic of Ireland, to identify modes of presentation, patient characteristics, comorbidities, management, and outcomes. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study of children and adolescents aged under 16 years with a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes in September 2023 using a standardized proforma.

pmc-12618753.title: The Signal Peptidase MoSpc2 Orchestrates Fungal Development, Protein Secretion and Pathogenicity in Magnaporthe oryzae
pmc-12618753.creator: Wei Tang, Min Wang, Ying Bao, Weiquan Chen, Yanfang Jiang, Meilian Chen, Xiaofeng Chen, Yingzi Yun, Zonghua Wang, Xiaomin Chen
pmc-12618753.description: The signal peptidase complex (SPC) is a crucial membrane enzyme complex involved in the process of protein secretion and maturation in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells. SPC is responsible for the cleavage of N-terminal signal sequences from nascent proteins, a sequence of amino acids that directs the newly synthesized protein to the secretory pathway.

pmc-13183472.title: Multidimensional analysis of concurrent proximal bronchiolar adenoma and lung carcinoma
pmc-13183472.creator: Lu-Yao Li, Gong-Ming Dong, Yun-Peng Zhang, Ting-Ting Wang, Fu-Quan Jia, Guan-Jun Zhang
pmc-13183472.description: Bronchiolar adenoma (BA) is a rare type of lung tumor characterized by bilayered epithelial cells having a continuous basal layer and a luminal layer. It resembles mucinous adenocarcinoma (MA) on frozen section, with difficulty in distinguishing the basal layer. Immunohistochemistry is the best choice for verifying the diagnosis.

pmc-13330995.title: The Initial Diagnostic Approach to Adult Congenital Heart Disease: A Practical Imaging Pathway for General Cardiologists and Cardiac Imagers
pmc-13330995.creator: Alicia Rangosch, Aneesh Dhore-Patil, Valeria E. Duarte
pmc-13330995.description: Adult congenital heart disease (ACHD) is among the most anatomically and physiologically complex domains in cardiovascular medicine. Advances in pediatric cardiac surgery and cardiology have shifted congenital heart disease (CHD) from a predominantly pediatric condition to a lifelong disease, resulting in a growing adult population that now outnumbers the affected children.

pmc-13556607.title: 35. Novel machine learning model combining consensus nested cross-validation and minimum redundancy maximum relevance for identifying current suicidal symptoms in young people with major affective disorders
pmc-13556607.creator: M-H Chen, H-J Wu, Y-M Bai, J-W Hsu, W-C Lin
pmc-13556607.description: BackgroundPrevious neuroimaging-based machine learning studies involving adolescents have achieved accuracies below 80% in identifying suicide risk, highlighting the limitations of traditional feature selection methods when applied to the developing brains of young individuals.Aims & ObjectivesThe study aimed to develop a neuroimaging-based machine learning predictive model for youth suicide.

pmc-13564268.title: Change in Association Between Minerals, Fatty Acids and Oxidative Stress Parameters in Wistar Rats with Different Diets
pmc-13564268.creator: Slavica Ranković, Tamara Popović, Nevena Vidović, Saša Janković, Mirjana Lukić, Nikola Prvulović, Jasmina Debeljak Martačić
pmc-13564268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryThis study examines how different diets affect female Wistar rats and the relationships between mineral levels, fatty acid composition, and oxidative stress, which is a process that can damage cells and contribute to disease. Our results showed that rats fed a standard diet and a fish-based diet had stronger interactions between minerals and fatty acids than those fed a milk-based diet. The standard diet produced the greatest number of relationships, suggesting a more complex balance between nutrients involved in liver metabolism.

pmc-13606557.title: One-Step Sol–Gel-Fabricated CuZn Alloy Aerogel Enabled by Cu–Zn Bimetallic Synergy for Efficient Antibacterial and Anti-Biofilm Therapy

pmc-13606557.description: Copper nanoparticles possess broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, and aerogels with 3D interconnected porous networks can trap bacteria and sustain metal ion release to boost bactericidal effects. Zinc is another low-toxicity antibacterial metal, and the Cu–Zn combination is predicted to generate synergistic inhibition.
